newsitem.title: USA: Impact of Fla. NERC area seen slight for utilities.
newsitem.headline: Impact of Fla. NERC area seen slight for utilities.

text.p: Formation this week of the Florida Reliability Coordinating Council (FRCC) is likely to have little impact on daily operations, like power scheduling, at the state's utilities, industry officials said.
"There would be no immediate impact on day-to-day operations," said FRCC general manager Ken Wiley.
The Florida subregion was cleared Tuesday by the North American Electric Reliability Council (NERC) to become NERC's 10th reliability district.
